page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left, a blank page with only show-through and stains; right, a title page cut off at the right edge of the scan, with its left part visible. Right page: one large word at the top, then short lines of title text in the centre, then one line near the lower middle.
page.notes: The left page is blank. Faint ghost lettering on it is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The right page is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so only the first letters of each line are visible; the rest of each line is lost. The large word at the top shows only a T. Round library stamps on the right page and a faint stamp on the left are excluded. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on the visible part of the page.
